back: The ability to pay short-term debts when they are due.
Current assets ÷ current liabilities, written x : 1.
(Current assets − inventory) ÷ current liabilities, written x : 1.
Inventory is the least liquid current asset: it must be sold, often on credit, before it becomes cash.
Below 1 : 1 is a warning sign; about 1.5-2 : 1 current ratio is usually comfortable; very high may mean idle resources.
Sell surplus stock, collect receivables faster, sell unused assets, replace overdraft with long-term finance, delay asset purchases.
Another name for the acid test ratio.
A profitable business can have poor liquidity, and a liquid business can be unprofitable.
